messages:
michelle_pm: Quick thread to lock the pilot acceptance gates for the Optimize Advisor pilot (batching, cache, quant recs + eval-triggered alerts). Need clear guardrails before we give ACME access.

jorge_eng: Summary of what we'll ship in pilot: heuristics recommender, per-route presets, int8 recommendation only, adaptive microbatch runtime toggle, KV cache with TTL, one-click apply in Console (manual apply for pilot). No auto-apply.

michelle_pm: Important: ACME wants an "undo" and audit log. Also needs per-route opt-out.

nina_cs: Confirmed. ACME requires per-route opt-out via API and a UI revert button. Audit log should show who applied what and when.

sara_ml: Eval safety: every recommendation triggers a short offline eval on the customer's corpus. If estimated quality drop > 1.5% relative we flag "needs review" and block one-click. If applied, post-apply eval compares live responses vs baseline and can fire alerts on relative drop >2% & abs drop >0.005.

tim_sre: Ops constraints: pilot must be feature-flagged per-customer & per-route, canary rollout (5% -> 25% -> 100%), global kill switch. Add circuit-breaker: if error-rate or e2e p99 worsens > X% we disable adaptive batching automatically.

marco_infra: Runtime knobs: chat route max_wait_ms 5-25ms; batch route 100-200ms. For KV cache use prefetch TTL to avoid cold starts. We'll provide batch_size_hist and cache_hit_rate metrics to Console.

jorge_eng: Prototype runtime config snippet:```yaml
opt_advisor:
  enabled: true
  mode: heuristics
  recommend_quant: int8
  routes:
    - name: chat
      adaptive_batching: true
      max_wait_ms: 15
      max_batch_size: 8
      cache_ttl_ms: 60000
    - name: summarization
      adaptive_batching: true
      max_wait_ms: 150
      max_batch_size: 64
  eval_alerts:
    rel_drop_threshold: 0.02
    abs_min_delta: 0.005
    sample_on_alert_duration_min: 30
```

sara_ml: Alert behavior: on alert -> sample 100% for 30m, route affected customer's traffic to FP fallback if auto-fallback enabled by CS, and capture samples for offline analysis. We must run PII obfuscation before storage.

michelle_pm: Launch criteria proposal (pilot): 1) staging soak 72h with chat p99 <= target on pilot config; 2) offline eval job completes <30m; 3) alerts fire on injected regressions; 4) canary toggle + revert tested; 5) docs + SDK example available.

jenna_product: Prioritization: pilot-tier feature. Timeline: Sprint A prototype heuristics + console mock; Sprint B eval hooks + apply/revert + canary + docs. Customer soak for 2 weeks before widening.

nina_cs: ACME requirement: export of config history for audits and simple JSON API to opt-out per-route. They also want cost delta estimates pre-apply.

jorge_eng: We'll add estimated perf/cost delta to the UI by running a quick profiler on a small sample. For cost estimates we show relative token-cost change and GPU utilization delta.

marco_infra: CI note: microbatching touches scheduler; I'll add a nightly perf test for representative sequences. Also adding a perf smoke in deploy pipeline.

ci-bot: Build queued: feature/opt-advisor-pilot -> staging (#8321)

tim_sre: Observability: add per-route charts for batch_size_dist, micro_wait_ms_pctls, cache_hit_rate, p50/p95/p99, applied_recs_count, revert_count, eval_alert_count. Also alert if sampling pipeline backlog grows.

michelle_pm: Decision check: int8 only for pilot? anyone object?

jorge_eng: Agree, keep int4 out of pilot.

sara_ml: Agree. int8 provides measurable gains with low risk.

jenna_product: Action items: jorge - deliver heuristics + perf table; sara - implement eval runner + default thresholds; marco - nightly perf tests + sampling pipeline; tim - canary controls + circuit-breaker; nina - ACME audit/opt-out API spec; jenna - PRD + customer comms. Please ack here when you start.

jorge_eng: Ack, starting prototyping now.

sara_ml: Ack, will wire eval infra and synthetic regression tests.

marco_infra: Ack, adding perf tests.

tim_sre: Ack, will build canary endpoints and kill-switch.

jenna_product: Ack, drafting PRD and runbook.

michelle_pm: Thanks team. I'll consolidate and post the PRD link here when live. Keep updates in this thread so I can fold into the final acceptance doc.
